CVE-2010-4647.title: Multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in the Help C ...
CVE-2010-4647.description: Multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities in the Help Contents web application (aka the Help Server) in Eclipse IDE before 3.6.2 allow remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via the query string to (1) help/index.jsp or (2) help/advanced/content.jsp.

CVE-2020-27225.title: In versions 4.18 and earlier of the Eclipse Platform, the Help Su ...
CVE-2020-27225.description: In versions 4.18 and earlier of the Eclipse Platform, the Help Subsystem does not authenticate active help requests to the local help web server, allowing an unauthenticated local attacker to issue active help commands to the associated Eclipse Platform process or Eclipse Rich Client Platform process.
